pr_title: Fix error on tuya devices not following strictly specs
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
For some devices, the json returned by the API are not following what the specs are saying [Standard Instruction Set](https://developer.tuya.com/en/docs/iot/f?id=K9gf46qujdmwb) with Data type Integer. To be able to use these devices, we cast the fields to their supposed types.

Add tests to be sure nothing is breaking the existing feature and add a test to check if a device that is not following the specs can be build.

In general, if the device does not follow specifications (in this case not properly exposing its range and capabilities), it should be reported with Tuya, so they can fix their API.

These bandaids will not help in the long run.

Have you contacted Tuya about this? What was their response?

> In general, if the device does not follow specifications (in this case not properly exposing its range and capabilities), it should be reported with Tuya, so they can fix their API.
> 
> These bandaids will not help in the long run.
> 
> Have you contacted Tuya about this? What was their response?

I completely agree with you.
No I didn't contact them 😞  I will do it right away.

I'm just afraid that they will say: "Yeah but it's not our fault but the manufacturer that did a mistake" and then I'm stuck because the manufacturer will never change the device conf.

I will keep you up to date when I have a response from tuya.
In the meantime, if you want to close this PR and continue the discussions on the issue I'm OK.

> I'm just afraid that they will say: "Yeah but it's not our fault but the manufacturer that did a mistake" and then I'm stuck because the manufacturer will never change the device conf.

In that case, we are probably not going to support those devices. We cannot support all devices, we knew that before starting this.

Issues has been fixed by opening a support ticket directly to tuya (See [#59299](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/59299#issuecomment-978199135)). So I no longer need this but maybe other will benefits. Up to you @frenck if you prefer to not include this I'm totally OK even if I think it can be useful because most people will only follow the doc, add the device to tuya's app and add the integration to HA and may encounter the issue. We can close it and add it later if a lot of people are complaining.

Let me know what your prefer or close it directly.

I'm opting to close in that case. In almost all cases Tuya fixes it on their end; which is the proper solution that benefits everybody.

Thanks for this @adescamps 👍 

And, if it is really needed, this PR can be re-opened and evaluated later.

../Frenck

issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hello,

I've a climate device from Avidsen (homefresh) that underline use the tuya platform. I've setup the device to be used by the tuya app and follow the doc to have everything working with tuya IOT and I can control it from the app so no issue from there.

When trying to include the device in HA, I get the following error:

```
2021-11-07 18:27:35 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.climate] Error while setting up tuya platform for climate
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 249, in _async_setup_platform

File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/tuya/climate.py", line 107, in async_setup_entry
async_discover_device([*hass_data.device_manager.device_map])
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/tuya/climate.py", line 99, in async_discover_device
TuyaClimateEntity(
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/tuya/climate.py", line 192, in __init__
self._attr_max_temp = type_data.max_scaled
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/tuya/base.py", line 33, in max_scaled
return self.scale_value(self.max)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/tuya/base.py", line 47, in scale_value
return value * 1.0 / (10 ** self.scale)
TypeError: can't multiply sequence by non-int of type 'float'
```

(Lines may differ because I edit the file to test a modification)

So the device cannot be included on home assistant.
